_comment: Golden table for the Connector v2 rule that a search query must not carry a URL.
Read by shared/contracts/src/__tests__/connector-ipc.test.ts and by the Connector's own tests,
which apply the published CONNECTOR_IPC_RULES.search_query_url_pattern rather than a second
grammar. A query the pattern matches is answered search_query_carries_url without reaching a provider.
The rule is lexical and ASCII-only: it refuses `://` and a dotted host followed by an optional
port and a slash. The notes below record the edges it decides on purpose.

cases.note: a bare host is a search term, not a URL
the last label has to start with a letter
refused although it is not a URL: the rule has no list of real top-level domains
a single-label host is not matched
the character classes are ASCII only
